facts: Ok-status responses from /health are cached for 5 seconds by the edge proxy.
So-called soft deletes set deleted_at in src/db.ts instead of removing the row.
Yes/no answers in the onboarding form are stored as booleans in answers.json.
No-op migrations still bump PRAGMA user_version so the ladder stays linear.
Also-ran candidates are dropped when their score falls below 35% of the best match.
Sure-fire retries are limited to 5 attempts with jittered backoff in retryBusy().
Now that WAL mode is on, readers never block the single writer in src/db.ts.
Well-formed JSON-RPC errors use code -32700 for parse failures and a null id.
Actually the hook budget is 2400 bytes per prompt and 4000 at session start.
We pin Node 20 and 22 in CI because better-sqlite3 ships prebuilt binaries for both.
We never write memory into the repo; everything lives under ~/.amem.
The release workflow publishes to npm only when NPM_TOKEN is set.
src/freshness.ts compares sha256 hashes of anchor files before falling back to mtime.
Claims longer than 2000 characters are rejected by updateClaim with a split hint.
redactSecrets keeps the key name and replaces only the value with [REDACTED].
Telemetry is off unless telemetry = true is set in ~/.amem/policy.toml.
The dashboard binds to 127.0.0.1:7843 and refuses non-loopback addresses.
Hooks attach only inside git checkouts and never in the home directory.
openDb sets busy_timeout before switching journal_mode to WAL.
Skill drafts are redacted with redactDeep before they are written to disk.
TEST-109 blocks six nightly transfer tests until the Zenus fix ships.
Windows renames can fail with EPERM, so replaceFile retries three times.
The FTS index is rebuilt by amem doctor --fix when row counts disagree.
Session start injects at most 8 personal memories from the last 7 days.
Just one writer runs at a time; BEGIN IMMEDIATE takes the lock up front.
Right now the MCP server registers 16 tools and 3 resources.
Personal memories marked kind private never appear in work repositories.
Every PR runs the test matrix on macOS, Ubuntu and Windows with Node 20 and 22.
The quote endpoint returns 422 when the corridor is not enabled for the customer.
Fixtures for the secret detector live in test/fixtures/secrets-corpus.json.
